stories.title: Nepal flash flood: Death toll rises to over 1,100, says police
stories.summary: Nepal’s devastating flash floods have killed over 1,100 people, with nearly 4,000 still missing. Rescue and relief operations continue as authorities search for survivors and provide aid to affected communities.

stories.title: ‘He was always a bit of a groundbreaker’: David Bowie enters a new dimension in ‘extended reality’ documentary
stories.summary: Hundreds of unseen images of the star feature at the Venice film festival, alongside virtual worlds exploring wildfires, wolves and the birth of stars David Bowie shares the bill with starmen, firefighters and Walt Disney wolves at the 10th anniversary edition of Venice Immersive, the film festival’s pioneering showcase for new forms of storytelling.
